crossRefs.note: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”
Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
“Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that…

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”
translations.bsb: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
translations.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
translations.asv: And from that city many of the Samaritans believed on him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me all things that ever I did.
